branch.model: a deep ancestor of the Mesoamerican families (Nahuatl/Maya); Andean/Quechua phonological tilt as flavor

_note: Elvish demihuman culture, the jungle-and-river branch of the Vaneth (family_elvish.json) and the setting's nearest 'dark-elf' analog. Harsh, guttural, clipped speech (glottal k'/t'/p', affricate tz, x = sh, -tl/-' finals); the HARSH branch-law on the Proto-Elvish roots. A fallen golden-age jungle theocracy of blood-temples, overwhelmingly Chaotic: weights {Chaotic 0.80, Neutral 0.10, Lawful 0.10}, though a realm can seed or drift to Neutral or Lawful. As the deep ancestor of the Mesoamerican human families, its deity- and concept-roots prefigure the human Maya/Nahua forms (Atyarnak'on -> Aiternatl/Aj Ternaj; Marak'on -> Tolratl/Tulax line). DEITY names take the Xilvaneth SACRED GENDERED ending -ak'on (masc) / -ak'el (fem) - the divine class, distinct from mortal -tl/-tzin/ix- and from the common-noun -tl; never real Maya/Nahua gods. Common-word lexicon and rank register may use the real Mesoamerican register (balam jaguar, itztli obsidian, cacao, centli maize, ihuitl feather) per catalog 5.3.

phonology.palette: Xilvaneth: harsh and guttural (the dark-elf branch); glottalization k'/t'/p'; the affricate tz and x (sh); -tl/-' finals; vowels reduce toward a/i/u; clipped syllables; the HARSH branch-law on the Proto-Elvish roots. Nahua/Maya and Andean/Quechua phonological tilt as flavor.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clipped clusters; frequent glottal stops; -tl/-tz finals; reduced vowels.

morphology.patronymic_form: the blood-house (wak'tl) by a blood-line; -tzin/-tl (of the line); ix- marks the feminine; a clipped use-name, a true-name hidden from enemies and demons alike.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality](harsh stem) + feature/realm: Itz-sirtl (obsidian-river), Xak-xilwatl (fierce-jungle); -van'tl for the realm, -anak for the seat.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a harsh jungle theocracy of blood-temples, now fallen to canopy-fastnesses; the T'aran over the elven blood-lords, the obsidian priesthood and the jaguar war-captains)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Harsh Xilvaneth reflexes of the Proto-Elvish title ladder, ascending - the same seven ACKS tiers as the smooth branches, glottalized and clipped. A fallen golden-age theocracy, now canopy-fastness enclaves. (These title-roots are ancestral to the human Mesoamerican lordly terms.)

people_name_convention.order: a clipped use-name + the house (wak'tl); a true-name hidden; ix- for the feminine; harsh two-element names.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the blood-houses carry an ancient house-name; a use-name is given, a true-name hidden from foes and demons alike.
people_name_convention.theophoric: mortal theophorics weave the venerated Chaotic power's ROOT (never the divine -ak'on/-ak'el ending) + harsh elements: -tzin (devotee), Itz-/Estl- (obsidian/blood): e.g. Marak-tzin (devotee of Marak'on), Rap'-ixel.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Xilvaneth (harsh) reflexes of the Proto-Elvish theonym roots (family_elvish.json) - the eldest forms of the Agrippan canon, never real Maya/Nahua gods; they carry the sacred GENDERED ending -ak'on (masc) / -ak'el (fem) - the divine class, distinct from mortal -tl/-tzin/ix- and common-noun -tl. The Xilvaneth are overwhelmingly Chaotic (weights C80/N10/L10); the worship/demonize set follows the realm's CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment), but the cultural default is the Chaotic blood-cult. The nelok'tl (pyramid-grove), its steps dark with offering, is the altar; the ek'tl (devouring ancestors) are fed there.
religion.the_one: Atyarnak'on (< Proto-Elvish Atyarnaaron < Aeternus; sacred-masculine ending -ak'on; among the overwhelmingly Chaotic Xilvaneth the One is the DEMONIZED enemy - 'the Sun-Jailer', the cold tyrant of the high sky who would cage the wild; revered only by the rare Lawful minority)

Maraxus.gloss: the war-fire and conquest; chief venerated power, masc.

Raptis.gloss: the blood-hunt, the Huntress; venerated, fem.

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and law; DEMONIZED as the Burning-Eye, masc.

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the overwhelming majority venerate the Chaotic powers (Marak'on the war-fire, Rap'ak'el the blood-hunt, Wakidak'on the void, Lusanak'on the hoard-serpent, Dementak'on the storm-madness), and demonize the One (Atyarnak'on the Sun-Jailer) and the Lawful powers (Tul'ak'on, Orlanak'on)
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: a rare fallen-from-grace minority reveres the One and the Lawful powers and demonizes the Chaotic powers - hunted as heretics by the blood-temples
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: ambivalent; the ek'tl (ancestral dead), the jungle-spirits, the jaguar and the serpent foremost

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (by current alignment): when Chaotic (the norm) - Aeternus -> Atyarnak'on the Sun-Jailer, Tulrius -> Tul'ak'on the Burning-Eye, Orlandus -> Orlanak'on the Iron-Chain; when Lawful - Maraxus -> Marak'on the Ruin.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Nelok'tl (pyramid-grove) of [power]: 'the Nelok'tl of Marak'on', its steps dark with offering.
religion.saints_pattern: the devouring ancestors and war-captains of the houses (the ek'tl), fed at the pyramid and the obsidian-stone.

holy_symbol_motifs.Marak'on: an obsidian blade over a victory-pyre
holy_symbol_motifs.Rap'ak'el: a jaguar's fang above a blood-drop
holy_symbol_motifs.Wakidak'on: a black void-maw swallowing a star

banks_patterns.ships: jungle river war-canoes, serpent-prowed: 'the Black Sirtl', 'Fang-of-the-River', 'the Obsidian Serpent'
banks_patterns.military_units: the jaguar-knights and blood-companies: 'the Obsidian Fangs', 'the Jaguar-cloaks of [house]'
banks_patterns.taverns: the blood-feast hall (elves keep halls, not taverns): 'the Hall of the Red Pyramid', 'the Cacao of Skulls'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen jungle blood-temples swallowed by the canopy: 'the sunken Nelok'tl of [house]', 'the Drowned Pyramid of [name]'
